```html
<!-- CommentComponent.blade.php -->

<div class="flex items-center justify-between p-4 bg-white shadow-md rounded-lg">
    <h3 class="text-xl font-bold">{{ $comment->user->name }} said:</h3>
    <p class="text-gray-600">{{ $comment->body }}</p>

    @auth
        <button wire:click="deleteComment({{ $comment->id }})">
            Delete Comment
        </button>
    @endauth
</div>
```

This Blade view includes a simple layout with the comment content and an "Edit" button for authenticated users. The delete button uses Alpine.js to handle the click event, which triggers the `deleteComment` method on the parent component when clicked.
